idle.note: blind listening: the hooded head tilts slowly one way then the other, a long slow breath in the torso, the robe halves sway out of phase, the free hand's fingers flex at its side; the staff stays planted; no whole-body bob

move.note: a slow hunched hobble: the staff plants ahead and takes the weight twice per tile, the feet shuffle under the swinging hem, the torso leans in

mark.note: lifts the staff high overhead, the hood tips up as if listening to the sky, the free hand opens upward; holds a beat at the top, then sweeps the crystal down along the marked line (contact)

land.note: lifts the staff a little, then drives its butt straight down into the floor with a hunched lurch (contact); the robe jolts and settles

bolt.note: tips the crystal forward at the target from the grip while the free hand flicks open toward it; the bolt looses at contact, then a small recoil

ward.note: draws the staff across in front of the body and hunches behind it while the free hand pulls the mantle close; holds, then eases back

death.note: the staff slips from the grip and topples forward; the seer sags and folds over into its spreading robe, hood bowed to the floor; terminal pose held
